measurement: Isolated NMDAR EPSC (AMPA and GABA-A blocked, holding potential and Mg2+ stated) in layer II/III pyramidal cells of burst slices at P13-P17, with a d-APV concentration series reported as percent of EPSC removed.
why_no_literature_can_substitute: No isolated NMDAR current exists for the preparation (brief); the nearest native readings are other regions, ages and read-outs (D07, D08), and competitive occupancy depends on the slice's own glutamate and Mg2+.

measurement: Fraction of the isolated NMDAR EPSC removed by a saturating ifenprodil-site NAM, with and without a Zn2+ chelator, at plateau and with time-matched vehicle.
why_no_literature_can_substitute: The recombinant ceilings (88 percent diheteromer, 32 percent triheteromer, 50 percent with 300 nM Zn2+) transfer only through an unknown native composition and unknown tonic Zn2+; the one native bound (about 30 percent) is a Table 2 NMDAR/AMPAR ratio (DATO, plus or minus about 10 percentage points, different cell groups) in visual cortex at room temperature.

measurement: The same slices exposed to TCN-201 at two measured co-agonist levels together with the NAM, to solve the three composition shares.
why_no_literature_can_substitute: Recombinant maxima exist for the triheteromer (72 percent) but the slice co-agonist level and native triheteromer share in these cells do not exist in any source.

measurement: Slice glycine/D-serine level (or a surmounting-concentration control) before any TCN-201 arm is read.
why_no_literature_can_substitute: TCN-201 potency is set by co-agonist occupancy (carried 22553026); a recombinant IC50 is not a slice concentration.

measurement: Verified fast-EPSC block by the chosen AMPA antagonist at matched evoked charge on two metrics, plus a primary selectivity paper for that compound.
why_no_literature_can_substitute: The AMPA antagonist identity is unresolved (perampanel culture only; NBQX and GYKI use-only); a bath concentration is not a measured block.

measurement: Recording Mg2+, K+, Zn2+, temperature and pH as measured bath values with blockers present, and the drug curves repeated at a second Mg2+ and K+ level.
why_no_literature_can_substitute: The source paper states no recording Mg2+; ifenprodil effect depends on Zn2+, glycine and pH, and the NMDAR block depends on Mg2+.

measurement: Percent of isolated NMDAR EPSC that d-APV must remove for burst abolition (the threshold x), in separate slices from those in M-N2.
why_no_literature_can_substitute: It fixes whether a NAM with a ceiling can reach the threshold at all; no source gives it.

measurement: The NMDAR component of the burst itself (voltage-clamp current or burst-associated NMDAR charge) and the percent of it removed by each drug, as opposed to the evoked-EPSC percent.
why_no_literature_can_substitute: An evoked EPSC under a brief high-glutamate transient understates d-APV block of a pool exposed to lower or slower glutamate; no source gives burst-associated NMDAR current for this preparation.

measurement: Glycine/D-serine level for the NAM arm as well as the TCN-201 arm.
why_no_literature_can_substitute: Glycine reduces ifenprodil inhibition at NR1A/NR2B (abstract of 7901753; full text unread); slice co-agonist level is unmeasured.

measurement: NAM ceiling and potency at slice temperature (35 C) and slice pH.
why_no_literature_can_substitute: All recombinant maxima read here are room-temperature oocyte values and the only native datum is a room-temperature slice (D07).

measurement: NAM equilibration time in the slice, with a time-matched vehicle arm.
why_no_literature_can_substitute: D07 used 40 min or more of pre-incubation; D08 used a 30 min infusion without a vehicle arm; no source gives equilibration at 35 C in 400-500 um slices.

measurement: d-APV potency shift against raised extracellular glutamate in these slices.
why_no_literature_can_substitute: Surmountability is carried as an IPOTESI; no source read bears on it.
